content: <rss version="2.0"><channel><title>ESPN NBA</title><link>https://www.espn.com/</link><description>ESPN public league news</description><item><title>Haliburton has 24 points and 10 assists as the Pacers beat the winless Nets 136-109</title><link>http://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401909862</link><description>— Tyrese Haliburton had 24 points, 10 assists and an All-Star Game-worthy dunk as the Indiana Pacers hammered the Brooklyn Nets 136-109 on Sunday night.</description><pubDate>Mon, 26 Oct 2026 00:49:58 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://s.espncdn.com/stitcher/sports/basketball/nba/events/401909862.png?templateId=espn.applewatch.awayhome.1" /></item><item><title>Indiana Pacers vs. Brooklyn Nets: Game Highlights</title><link>https://www.espn.com/video/clip/_/id/50283149/game-highlights</link><description>Indiana Pacers vs. Brooklyn Nets: Game Highlights</description><pubDate>Mon, 26 Oct 2026 01:19:22 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://espnmedia-cdn.akamaized.net/espn/media/common/wsc/2026/1026/403c07cb-ef41-49ec-80b8-5c3172129028/403c07cb-ef41-49ec-80b8-5c3172129028.jpg" /></item><item><title>Luka Doncic scores NBA season-high 52 points, with 8 3s, in Lakers' win vs. Jazz</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50282749/luka-doncic-scores-nba-season-high-52-points-lakers-win-vs-jazz</link><description>Luka Doncic scored 52 points, hitting eight 3-pointers, to lead the Lakers to a 132-123 victory over the Jazz on Sunday. It was the first 50-point game this season in the NBA.</description><pubDate>Mon, 26 Oct 2026 01:03:34 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1026/r1736257_600x400_3-2.jpg" /></item><item><title>Luka Doncic scores NBA season-high 52 points in the Lakers' victory over the Jazz</title><link>http://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401909861</link><description>— Luka Doncic scored 52 points, hitting eight 3-pointers, to lead the Los Angeles Lakers to a 132-123 victory over the Utah Jazz on Sunday.</description><pubDate>Sun, 25 Oct 2026 23:58:47 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://s.espncdn.com/stitcher/sports/basketball/nba/events/401909861.png?templateId=espn.applewatch.awayhome.1" /></item><item><title>Raptors' Kawhi Leonard to miss Wolves game with knee swelling</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50281331/kawhi-leonard-miss-timberwolves-game-knee-swelling</link><description>Raptors star Kawhi Leonard is out for Sunday night's game against the Timberwolves due to left knee swelling.</description><pubDate>Sun, 25 Oct 2026 22:29:57 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1025/r1736163_600x400_3-2.jpg" /></item><item><title>Sixers overrule Embiid, sit center with plantar fasciitis management</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50279725/76ers-rule-embiid-plantar-fasciitis-management</link><description>Despite publicly calling to play Sunday against the Pistons, the 76ers decided to sit Joel Embiid due to right foot plantar fasciitis management.</description><pubDate>Sun, 25 Oct 2026 23:27:21 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/0904/r1711559_600x400_3-2.jpg" /></item></channel></rss>
